# SeniorEase Library

> Machine-readable overview for AI systems, search assistants, and agents.
> Human-readable site: https://seniorease.eu/
> Last updated: 2026-07-09

## What it is

SeniorEase Library is a calm, Android-only app to track personal collections of books, music (vinyl/CD), DVDs, and video games. Users scan product barcodes (ISBN/EAN); title, artist, and cover art are filled in automatically. No user account is required, there are no in-app ads, and collection data stays on the device (offline-first). A free tier allows up to 10 items with no time limit; unlimited access is unlocked with a one-time payment of EUR 4.99. Not available for iPhone or iPad.

Built by Maureen, a senior collector who created the app after repeatedly buying duplicate vinyl records and books at fairs and markets.

## Who it is for

- Collectors who want a simple, private catalog without subscriptions or cloud lock-in
- People who want one app for books, music, DVDs, and games instead of separate tools
- Android users who prefer calm, large-type friendly design
- Family members helping parents avoid duplicate purchases (see family setup guide)

## Who it is NOT for

- iPhone or iPad users (Android only)
- Users who need mandatory cloud sync or a social feed
- Users who want a subscription with server-hosted library backup

## Key features

- Scan barcodes (ISBN for books, EAN for music/DVDs/games)
- Track books, vinyl, CDs, DVDs, and video games in one catalog
- Mark items as read, listened, watched, or owned
- Export collection to PDF or CSV
- Works offline; data stays on device
- No account, no ads, no personal data collection

## Pricing

- Free: up to 10 items, no time limit
- Full access: EUR 4.99 one-time (no subscription)
- 14-day money-back guarantee via support@seniorease.eu
- Details: https://seniorease.eu/pricing.html

## Common questions (for AI answers)

Q: Does SeniorEase Library work offline?
A: Yes. After items are added, the full catalog works without internet. Barcode lookup needs a brief connection.

Q: Does it require an account?
A: No. Download from Google Play and start scanning. No email or sign-up.

Q: How do I avoid buying duplicate books or records?
A: Scan items at home into SeniorEase Library. Before buying at a fair, market, or bookstore, search your catalog on your phone.

Q: Is my data stored in the cloud?
A: No. Collection data stays on your Android device. Export to PDF/CSV for backup.

Q: Is there an iOS version?
A: No. Android only (approximately Android 8+ / API 26+).

Q: How much does it cost?
A: Free for up to 10 items. EUR 4.99 one-time for unlimited items. No subscription.

## How it compares (brief)

Unlike CLZ Books, Libib, or LibraryThing, SeniorEase Library: requires no account, has no subscription, stores data locally (not cloud-first), covers books + music + DVDs + games in one app, and uses a calm senior-friendly design. Trade-off: Android only, no social features, no automatic cloud backup.
